name: Pomegranate juice
description: Deep red, tart and astringent — pressed seeds and nothing else.

tcm.note: Shi liu is warm and astringent in the Chinese reading.

ayurveda.note: Dadima is shita and tridosha-pacifying — sour yet cooling, like amla.

unani.note: Anar is firmly thanda in desi and Unani usage, given in fevers.

effects.note: A meta-analysis of 14 randomised trials in 573 participants found pomegranate juice lowered systolic blood pressure by roughly 5 mmHg against placebo — unusually, servings of 300ml a day or less outperformed larger ones, the opposite of the usual dose-response pattern. A glass a day sits inside the range most of the trials used. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
